hypothesis: Layer 3 with a growing formation rate (claim C_L3_ASYMMETRIC_DIVISION): in an exponentially growing budding-yeast population, the population doubling time follows from the single-cell parent and daughter generation times through 2^{-P/T} + 2^{-D/T} = 1.

observable.quantity: population doubling time T for five cycloheximide conditions
observable.domain: S. cerevisiae C276 on YNB agar at 22-24 C, cycloheximide 0 to 0.060 ug/ml (Hartwell and Unger 1977, Table I)

prediction_method.description: T_pred solves 2^{-P/T} + 2^{-D/T} = 1 with P = 1st parent and D = daughter mean generation times; sigma_T propagates sd/sqrt(22) of P and D; z = |T_pred - T_obs| / sigma_T per condition. Secondary, not deciding: percent of unbudded cells that are daughters with the authors' budded-interval regression, against Table II.

fixed_parameters: one parent cycle and one daughter cycle per division, no dispersion (model of Fig. 4)
P = first parent generation time, D = daughter generation time, as tabulated
n = 22 cells per mean for the standard error (AI choice; not reported per condition)
pass_criterion: max z <= 2 over the five conditions
fail_criterion: max z > 3 -> FAILED; 2 < max z <= 3 -> INCONCLUSIVE
note: Disclosure: not blind. The drafting run computed T_pred = 152.8, 164.9, 225.5, 240.7, 304.9 min against 155, 167, 220, 245, 321 (largest deviation 5.0 percent at 0.060 ug/ml), max z about 1.8 with n = 22 and 1.5 with n = 15; the authors made the same comparison in Table I. The secondary comparison shows tension at the 220 min plate (86.4 +- 1.7 percent observed vs 78.5 predicted, z about 4.7) but uses a budded interval derived from budded-cell counts, so it is reported, not deciding. The n per condition is an AI choice: a smaller n makes PASS easier. Values were transcribed from scraped text of a scanned PDF; on 2026-11-17 they were re-checked against that extracted text (all match, and the authors' Calculated column equals T_pred), but not against the printed page. The model ignores dispersion of cycle times (10-20 min frames). Not UET-distinct: this is standard age-structured population dynamics. Approved by the author on 2026-11-17 as drafted, including n = 22 and the transcription checked against the extracted tables (not the printed page).
